ip-rb.label: SRH runs per innings, 2019–2022
ip-rb.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
ip-rb.query: WITH bat AS (SELECT d.innings_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.batter_id) batters FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id), bowl AS (SELECT d.innings_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.bowler_id) bowlers FROM deliveries d GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2023 THEN 'impact' ELSE 'before' END era, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (1) THEN 'team' ELSE 'rest' END side, AVG(bat.batters) batters, AVG(i.runs) runs, COUNT(*) n FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id JOIN bat ON bat.innings_id = i.innings_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2019 GROUP BY era, side
